args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was ~18% across us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Action taken: rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release marked healthy in production, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback reports VERIFIED and all three regions now run v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production; v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Follow-up: confirm error rate and health checks have recovered, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Rollback:** The most recent release that was healthy in production is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only deployed to staging. us-east, us-west, and eu-west are all now on v2.3.0, and the rollback reports as verified.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failed v2.3.1 deploy (about 18% error rate before the rollback), the rollback to v2.3.0, and the follow-up work.

I haven't re-checked health or error rate since the rollback, so that still needs confirming. The v2.3.1 failure also needs investigating before it is re-released.
